commits.subject: Scale the em to 1024 as src/generate.py did
commits.body:
The fonts google/fonts ships were generated by this family's original
src/generate.py (googlefontdirectory-hg e6ab8ab47), which ran f.em = 1024 in
FontForge 20100501 before exporting the .ttf; the release's FFTM timestamp is
that FontForge's build stamp. This applies the same change, ported from
FontForge's code: the released glyf is reproduced point for point, and every
advance width, in all four styles. The underline is written as integers,
which FontForge exports to the same bytes.

commits.subject: Set the Italic's Win ascent to 880, as the release carries
commits.body:
FontForge's em change left each composite's cached bounding box as its
unscaled components plus a scaled offset, so the release's font bounding box --
which this source's Win ascent follows -- is 880, one unit below Scaron's
outline (881). Stated absolutely to reproduce the release, including that
1-unit clip.

commits.subject: Set the Italic's hhea ascender to 880, as the release carries
commits.body:
The same stale bounding box as the Win ascent: hhea.ascender 880, stated
absolutely to reproduce the release.

future_work: Raise Puritan Italic's Win ascent and hhea ascender from 880 to 881, so the top of Scaron is not clipped. 880 is a stale bounding box left by FontForge's em change; the two commits that reproduce it can be reverted.
